text: Harriet Beecher Stowe's Uncle Tom's Cabin was published in 1851 and became an instant bestseller. Southern slaveholders burned copies and banned it from bookshelves because of its anti-slavery message. In later years, school districts across the United States banned the book for its use of racist language.
